==Transportation==
*[[Skills necklace]] teleport to the [[Cooks' Guild]].
*[[Varrock Teleport]] and run west.
*[[Chronicle]] teleport and run north-west.
*[[Combat bracelet]] teleport to the [[Champions' Guild]].
*[[Skull sceptre]] or [[skull sceptre (i)]] teleport and run east.
*[[Spirit tree]] to the [[Grand Exchange]].
